🩸 RAGDOLL REALITY – every hit is real.

Dummies react exactly where you hit them. Shoot a leg and they limp or crawl. Hit an arm and it dangles while they clutch the wound.

🧟 HALLOWEEN UPDATE
• Throw dummies into the graveyard, they rise as ZOMBIES!
• Slow, normal and fast zombies that chase, pounce and bite
• Bitten dummies get infected and turn
• Press the Horde button and survive the zombie wave

💥 REAL PHYSICS
• Dummies stumble, fight back, run away and get back up
• Limbs come off, wounds
